title: Tarik Nafas Dulu
genre: Malay wedding pop (lagu kahwin akad nikah duet)
mood: sentimental, nervous and laughing at itself
subject: a groom whose lafaz sticks on the mas kahwin amount at the akad nikah until the tok kadi tells him to breathe, and the second try that makes it sah
caption: Malay wedding pop in the lagu kahwin akad nikah duet style. A kompang ensemble playing interlocking bertingkah patterns in the intro and outro like an arak pengantin procession, with rebana underneath; a nylon-string acoustic guitar picking through the verses; warm piano chords; a soft 4/4 kit played with brushes and rim clicks. Warm and roomy, the kompang forward only in the intro and outro, the two voices close and on top. A warm male-female duet, sentimental and unhurried, trading verses and singing the last chorus in unison. 96 BPM, A major. Sentimental, nervous and laughing at itself. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM build, no dangdut beat, no power-ballad key change, no swelling string section, no nasyid choir harmonies, no lagu raya accordion.
lyrics:
[Intro - kompang bertingkah and nylon guitar]

[Verse 1 - Male]
Songkok baru, sampin pinjam abang ipar
Tok kadi genggam tangan aku, sejuk macam ais
Satu masjid senyap, kipas siling pun aku dengar
Lafaz aku tersangkut tengah jalan, kat angka mas kahwin

[Pre-Chorus - Female]
Dari belakang aku nampak telinga dia merah
Mak aku dah pegang tisu, abah aku pandang lantai

[Chorus - Duet]
Tok kadi senyum, "Tarik nafas dulu"
Sekali lagi, perlahan, satu-satu
Bila saksi angguk, "Sah"
Baru aku boleh bernafas

[Verse 2 - Female]
Petang tu atas pelamin, mak andam betulkan selendang
Dia bisik kat aku, "Malu, satu masjid gelak"
Aku kata, "Takpe, abang, cerita ni kita bawa sampai tua"
Video tu adik aku dah hantar dalam group keluarga

[Bridge - kompang falls away, guitar and piano]
Kalau abang tersangkut lagi satu hari nanti
Aku ada sebelah, aku ingatkan, tarik nafas dulu

[Chorus - Duet, in unison]
Tok kadi senyum, "Tarik nafas dulu"
Sekali lagi, perlahan, satu-satu
Kali kedua, suara tak goyang langsung
Dan satu masjid sebut "Sah" sama-sama

[Outro - kompang procession fading]
Arak pengantin, kompang di depan
Tarik nafas dulu, sayang
